```{r setup}
# Oddsratio Stargazer
stargazer2 <- function(model, odd.ratio = FALSE, ...) {
  if(!("list" %in% class(model))) model <- list(model)
  if (odd.ratio) {
    coefOR2 <- lapply(model, function(x) round(exp(stats::coefficients(x)),2))
    seOR2 <- lapply(model, function(x) round(exp(stats::coefficients(x)) * summary(x)$coef[, 2],2))
    p2 <- lapply(model, function(x) round(summary(x)$coefficients[, 4],2))
    stargazer::stargazer(model, coef = coefOR2, se = seOR2, p = p2, ...)
  } else {
    stargazer::stargazer(model, ...)
  }
}
```

# FAO Berechnung

## FAO Berechnung Gesamt

```{r}
library(RM.weights)
library(openxlsx)

SAMPLE <- "Gesamt"
dtfao <- dt[,c(grep("f9_",names(dt),value=T),"id","weight"),with=F]
# SAMPLE <- "Online"
# dtfao <- dt[,c(grep("f9_",names(dt),value=T),"id","weight"),with=F]

# set up file
## calculate raw scores
dtfao <- dtfao[,lapply(.SD,as.numeric)]
cols <- names(dtfao)[c(1:8)]
dtfao[,(cols):=lapply(.SD,function(x) ifelse(x>2,NA,x)),.SDcols=cols]
dtfao[,(cols):=lapply(.SD,function(x) x-1),.SDcols=cols]
## add raw score
dtfao[,rs:=rowSums(.SD),.SDcols=cols]
## code cases for validation and callibration
dtfao[,valid:=!is.na(rs)&rs!=0&rs!=8]
## add hsize
dt[,hsize:=as.numeric(gsub("\\D","",as.character(r_personen)))]
dtfao[,hsize:=dt[match(dtfao$id,dt$id),hsize]]
## table on hsize and rs
dtfao[,.N,.(hsize,rs)][order(-hsize)]
## --> remove households without hsize to enable individual level calculation (2 of 6 are non-food insecure; 2 have an unknown rs)
dtfao <- dtfao[!is.na(hsize)]

# Validity indicators
## 4. total size
dtfao[,.N]
## 5. 7.  number and percent of valid data. 
dtfao[,.N,rs][,percent:=N/sum(N)*100][order(rs),.SD]
## 6.  number of invalid cases by item
fun.sum <- function(x) sum(is.na(x))
rbind(`valid percent`=unlist(lapply(dtfao[,1:8],fun.sum))/dim(dtfao)[1]*100,
`valid n`=unlist(lapply(dtfao[,1:8],fun.sum)))
## 8. sample size validation
dtfao[,.N,valid]
## write.table(data.table(tmp)[,lapply(.SD,round,2)],"clipboard",sep="\t")

## VALIDATION
AT_VAL <- RM.w(as.matrix(dtfao[valid==T,grep("f9_",names(dtfao)),with=F])
                              ,.w = dtfao[valid==T,weight],
                              country="Austria")

aff_res <- dtfao[valid==T,grep("f9_",names(dtfao)),with=F][,lapply(.SD,sum)][,unlist(.SD)]
tmp <- data.table(label=c("WORRIED","HEALTHY","FEWFOOD","SKIPPED","ATELESS","RANOUT","HUNGRY","WHLDAY"),
           `item parameter`=round(AT_VAL$b,2),
           `Standard error`=round(AT_VAL$se.b,2),
           infit=round(AT_VAL$infit,2),
           outfit=round(AT_VAL$outfit,2),
`affirmitive responses`= aff_res,
`affirmitive responses (share)`= round(aff_res/346*100,2))
tmp
# write.table(tmp, "clipboard", sep="\t", row.names=FALSE)
## Residual correclation
abs(AT_VAL$res.corr)>.4
## rasch reliab
c("reliability:",round(AT_VAL$reliab,3))


## KALIBRATION
dtfao[,kalib:=!is.na(rs)]
dim(dtfao)[1]-sum(dtfao$kalib)
sum(dtfao$kalib)
rr <- RM.w(as.matrix(dtfao[kalib==T,grep("f9_",names(dtfao)),with=F])
                              ,.w = dtfao[kalib==T,weight],
                              country="AT_FS")
rrh <- RM.w(as.matrix(dtfao[kalib==T,grep("f9_",names(dtfao)),with=F])
                              ,.w = dtfao[kalib==T,weight*hsize],
                              country="AT_FS_HS")

## to calibrate in Excel write excel file
wb <- loadWorkbook(file.path(DIR_FIES, "FIES_tmpl.xlsx"))
writeData(wb,sheet = 1,startCol = 3,startRow = 28,x = rr$b)
writeData(wb,sheet = 1,startCol = 6,startRow = 27,x = rr$a)
writeData(wb,sheet = 1,startCol = 7,startRow = 27,x = rr$se.a)
writeData(wb,sheet = 1,startCol = 8,startRow = 27,x = rrh$wt.rs)
saveWorkbook(wb,file = file.path(DIR_FIES, paste0("FIES_",SAMPLE,".xlsx")),overwrite = T)


## read excel file after calibration
wb <- loadWorkbook(file.path(DIR_FIES, paste0("FIES_",SAMPLE,"c.xlsx")))
# system(paste0("open FIES/FIES_",SAMPLE,"c.xlsx"))
## Indicators
# 13. NA cases
dtfao[is.na(rs),.N]
# 14. Cases used
dtfao[kalib==T,.N]

# N_items
data.table(readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=6:14,cols=3:5,colNames = F)) 
  data.table(readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=6:14,cols=3:4,colNames = F))[,X1[is.na(X2)]]


corr<- readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=15,cols=4,colNames = F)
corr
N_items<- dim(readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=6:14,cols=4,colNames = F))[1]
N_items
## Thresholds
readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=38:39,cols=8:9,colNames = F)
## read probabilities
prob_fies <- data.table(readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=40:50,cols=c(6,8:9),colNames = T))
prob_fies[,lapply(.SD,round,2)]
# write.table(prob_fies[,lapply(.SD,round,2)],"clipboard",sep="\t",row.names=FALSE)
setnames(prob_fies,c("rs","p_ms","p_s"))
## prevalence rates
 data.table(readWorkbook(wb,1,rows=40:41,cols=c(10:11),colNames = T))[,lapply(.SD,round,4)]

dtfao_gesamt <- copy(dtfao)
prob_fies_gesamt <- copy(prob_fies)

 threshold_rs_ms <- prob_fies_gesamt[p_ms >= 0.5, min(rs)]
threshold_rs_s  <- prob_fies_gesamt[p_s  >= 0.5, min(rs)]

cat("Moderate+severe threshold: rs >=", threshold_rs_ms, "\n")
cat("Severe threshold: rs >=", threshold_rs_s, "\n")
```

## FAO Berechnung Online

```{r}



library(RM.weights)
library(openxlsx)

SAMPLE <- "Online"
dtfao <- dt[r_methode=="Online",c(grep("f9_",names(dt),value=T),"id","weight"),with=F]

# set up file
## calculate raw scores
dtfao <- dtfao[,lapply(.SD,as.numeric)]
cols <- names(dtfao)[c(1:8)]
dtfao[,(cols):=lapply(.SD,function(x) ifelse(x>2,NA,x)),.SDcols=cols]
dtfao[,(cols):=lapply(.SD,function(x) x-1),.SDcols=cols]
## add raw score
dtfao[,rs:=rowSums(.SD),.SDcols=cols]
## code cases for validation and callibration

## add hsize
```

# Regressionsanalyse march 2026

## Hilfsfunktion: dtl → wide mit Mehrfachantworten und NA/None-Overrides

```{r recode-helpers}
# Die meisten Fragebogenblöcke (f7, f9b, f11) haben dasselbe Muster:
# dtl nach qid-Präfix filtern, items per fcase(grepl(...)) mappen,
# zu wide casten und anschließend einige ids auf NA / 0 setzen (für
# "keine Angabe" / "Nein" / "keiner der genannten Gründe").
# Diese Funktion bündelt das.
#
# Args:
#   qid_pattern      Regex für qid (z.B. "^f7")
#   item_map         named character vector: fcase-grepl Muster -> Zielspaltenname
#   na_trigger_qlbs  qlb-Werte, die eine komplette id auf NA setzen
#   zero_trigger_qlbs qlb-Werte, die eine komplette id auf 0 setzen
#   exclude_from_body qlbs, die beim eigentlichen Mapping ignoriert werden
dtl_to_wide <- function(qid_pattern,
                        item_map,
                        na_trigger_qlbs   = c("Weiß ich nicht","weiß ich nicht","keine Angabe"),
                        zero_trigger_qlbs = character(0),
                        exclude_from_body = c(na_trigger_qlbs, zero_trigger_qlbs)) {

  na_ids   <- dtl[grepl(qid_pattern, qid) & qlb %chin% na_trigger_qlbs   & itlb == "genannt", unique(id)]
  zero_ids <- dtl[grepl(qid_pattern, qid) & qlb %chin% zero_trigger_qlbs & itlb == "genannt", unique(id)]

  # Mapping qlb -> Zielspalte per fcase-Argumentliste aufbauen
  build_case <- function(qlb_vec) {
    out <- rep(NA_character_, length(qlb_vec))
    for (pat in names(item_map)) {
      hit <- grepl(pat, qlb_vec) & is.na(out)
      out[hit] <- item_map[[pat]]
    }
    out
  }

  wide <- dtl[grepl(qid_pattern, qid) & !qlb %chin% exclude_from_body][
    , .(id, item = build_case(qlb), value = as.integer(itlb == "genannt"))
  ][!is.na(item)] |>
    dcast(id ~ item, value.var = "value", fill = 0)

  cols <- setdiff(names(wide), "id")
  wide[id %in% na_ids,   (cols) := NA]
  wide[id %in% zero_ids, (cols) := 0L]
  wide[]
}
```



## create table for regression

### Basis für md: eine Zeile pro Respondent

Alle analytischen Variablen werden direkt mit ihren finalen Namen
(`ih_*`, `ip_*`, `com_*`, `ctrl_*`, `out_*`, `fp_*`) in `md` gebaut.
Kein `dtr`, kein nachträglicher Rename-Schritt.

```{r md-init}
library(data.table)

md <- dt[, .(id)]
```

### Demographie (ih_dem)

```{r ih_dem}
md[, ih_dem_age := dt[match(md$id, dt$id), f5]]

md[, ih_dem_gender := factor(
  fcase(dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesch] == "Mann",  "male",
        dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesch] == "Frau",  "female"),
  levels = c("male", "female"))]

md[, ih_dem_migration := factor(
  fcase(dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_migr] == "Kein Migrationshintergrund",   "none",
        dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_migr] %in% c("1. Grades", "2. Grades"),  "migration_background"),
  levels = c("none", "migration_background"))]

md[, ih_dem_children := fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "kein Kind",          0L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "1 Kind",             1L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "2 Kinder",           2L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "3 Kinder",           3L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "4 Kinder",           4L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_kinder] == "5 oder mehr Kinder", 5L
)]
```

### Status (ih_st)

```{r ih_st}
md[, ih_st_employment := factor(fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_erwe] == "erwerbstätig",                    "employed",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_erwe] == "arbeitslos bzw. arbeitssuchend",  "unemployed",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_erwe] == "in Pension",                      "retired",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_erwe] %in% c(
    "haushaltsführend", "andere Tätigkeit",
    "in Ausbildung (Lehre, Schule, Studium)",
    "dauerhaft arbeitsunfähig aus gesundheitlichen Gründen"),           "out_of_labour_force"
))]

md[, ih_st_education := factor(fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_ausb] %in%
    c("Kein Schulabschluss", "Pflichtschulabschluss"),                          "low",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_ausb] %in%
    c("Lehrabschluss", "Fachschule / berufsbildende mittlere Schule"),          "medium",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_ausb] %in%
    c("Matura", "Fachhochschule oder Universität"),                             "high"
), levels = c("high", "medium", "low"))]
```

### Intrahaushalt: Lebensbedingungen (ih_lc)

Haushaltstyp wird hier 2-stufig (single- vs. multi-adult) als Rohvariable
für die Imputation angelegt. Die 4-stufige Haushaltskomposition
(`ih_lc_hhcomp`) wird nach der Imputation aus `ih_dem_children` +
`ih_lc_hhtype` abgeleitet (siehe `add_hhcomp()`).

```{r ih_lc}
md[, ih_lc_health := fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesu] == "Sehr schlecht", 5L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesu] == "Schlecht",      4L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesu] == "Mittelmäßig",   3L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesu] == "Gut",           2L,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_gesu] == "Sehr gut",      1L
)]

md[, ih_lc_urban := factor(fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_urb] == "niedrig", "low",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_urb] == "mittel",  "medium",
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_urb] == "hoch",    "high"
), levels = c("low", "medium", "high"))]

md[, ih_lc_hhsize := as.integer(gsub("[^0-9]", "", dt[match(md$id, dt$id), r_personen]))]
md[, ih_lc_hhtype := factor(fcase(
  pmax(ih_lc_hhsize - ih_dem_children, 0) == 1, "single-adult",
  pmax(ih_lc_hhsize - ih_dem_children, 0) >= 2, "multi-adult"
), levels = c("multi-adult", "single-adult"))]
```

### Intrahaushalt: Ernährungsentscheidungen (ih_fc) — aus f7

11 binäre Items, nicht in einen Latent gezwungen. Theoretisch relevant
für Ernährungsarmut: Preis, Einfachheit, Hunger, Gesundheit.

```{r ih_fc}
f7_items <- c(
  "Appetit"      = "ih_fc_appetite",
  "Preis"        = "ih_fc_price",
  "Gewicht"      = "ih_fc_weight",
  "Emotion"      = "ih_fc_emotion",
  "andere tun"   = "ih_fc_social_norm",
  "Eindruck"     = "ih_fc_impression",
  "Gewohnheit"   = "ih_fc_habit",
  "Hunger"       = "ih_fc_hunger",
  "Gesundheit"   = "ih_fc_health",
  "Einfachheit"  = "ih_fc_convenience",
  "Genuss"       = "ih_fc_enjoyment",
  "Traditionen"  = "ih_fc_tradition",
  "Umwelt"       = "ih_fc_environment",
  "Gemeinschaft" = "ih_fc_community"
)
f7_wide <- dtl_to_wide(
  qid_pattern       = "^f7",
  item_map          = f7_items,
  na_trigger_qlbs   = c("weiß ich nicht", "keine Angabe"),
  zero_trigger_qlbs = c("keiner der genannten Gründe")
)
md <- merge(md, f7_wide, by = "id", all.x = TRUE)
```

### Ernährungsmuster — aus f6 (binarisiert)

```{r diet}
diet_long <- dtl[qid == "f6", .(id,
  diet_pattern = fcase(
    grepl("alles.*Fleisch.*Milch",                itlb), "omnivore",
    grepl("vegetarisch.*ab und zu Fleisch",       itlb), "flexitarian",
    grepl("Fisch.*kein Fleisch",                  itlb), "pescatarian",
    grepl("Milch.*Eier.*kein Fleisch.*kein Fisch",itlb), "vegetarian",

)]
md[, diet_pattern_omnivore := factor(
```

### Interpersonal: Soziales Ernährungsumfeld (ip_fe) — aus f9b und f13

f9b: Einladen/Besuchen-Kontexte (Freunde, Gasthaus, Kaffeehaus, Hosting).
Triggered von "Nein" (alle 0), "Weiß ich nicht"/"keine Angabe" (alle NA).

```{r ip_fe_f9b}
f9b_items <- c(
  "Freunden"    = "ip_fe_friends",
  "Gasthaus"    = "ip_fe_restaurant",
  "Kaffeehaus"  = "ip_fe_cafe",
  "einzuladen"  = "ip_fe_host"
)
f9b_wide <- dtl_to_wide(
  qid_pattern       = "^f9b",
  item_map          = f9b_items,
  na_trigger_qlbs   = c("Weiß ich nicht", "keine Angabe"),
  zero_trigger_qlbs = c("Nein")
)
md <- merge(md, f9b_wide, by = "id", all.x = TRUE)
```

Mensa-Variablen (f13): Kosten / Verfügbarkeit / Zeit-oder-Motivation.
Dieselbe Logik, nur andere f13_X Spalte.

- f13_6 = "keine Angabe" → NA
- f12_5 = "nicht genannt" (Mensa gar nicht genutzt) → 0
- f12_6 = "keine Angabe" → NA

```{r ip_fe_mensa}
build_mensa <- function(dt_in, f13_col) {
  v <- ifelse(dt_in[[f13_col]] == "genannt", 1, 0)
  v[dt_in$f13_6 == "genannt"]      <- NA
  v[dt_in$f12_5 == "nicht genannt"] <- 0
  v[dt_in$f12_6 == "genannt"]      <- NA
  v
}
md[, ip_fe_mensa_cost  := build_mensa(dt, "f13_3")[match(md$id, dt$id)]]
md[, ip_fe_mensa_avail := build_mensa(dt, "f13_1")[match(md$id, dt$id)]]
md[, ip_fe_mensa_timo  := build_mensa(dt, "f13_4")[match(md$id, dt$id)]]
```

### Interpersonal: Einkaufsorte (ip_sh) — aus f11

Mehrfachantworten als binäre Indikatoren. Sozialmarkt und Tafel sind
als schwere Coping-Marker theoretisch zentral.

```{r ip_sh}
f11_items <- c(
```

```{r com_walk_dist}
                       .(g_id, plz = as.integer(paste0(1, sprintf("%02d", 1:23), 0)))])

  plz  = c(4010, 4220, 4670, 4856, 5334, 6053, 6237, 8032, 9010, 9031, 9455),
  g_id = c(40101,41605,40807,40701,40436,70346,70501,60101,20101,20101)
)

## PLZ-Bereinigung (direkt auf dt, weil f2 dort lebt)

dt[plz == 5920, plz := NA]

## Fehlende PLZ diagnostisch auflisten
merge(dt[,.(id,plz)], walk[,.(walk23_mean_plz,plz)], by = "plz", all.x = T)[is.na(walk23_mean_plz)][, plz]
```

### Outcomes und FIES-Kategorien (out_*, fies_*, fp_child)

```{r outcomes}
# FIES-Rohwahrscheinlichkeiten und Kategorien aus dt übernehmen
md[, p_ms_gesamt  := dt[match(md$id, dt$id), p_ms.gesamt]]
md[, p_s_gesamt   := dt[match(md$id, dt$id), p_s.gesamt]]

# Beta-regression-tauglich (Smithson-Verkuilen-Transformation)
n <- nrow(md)
md[, out_fies_ms := (p_ms_gesamt * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n]
md[, out_fies_s  := (p_s_gesamt  * (n - 1) + 0.5) / n]

# FIES-Kategorien (severe -> moderate kollabiert, als Faktor)
fies_suffixes <- c("gesamt", "online", "telefon")
for (s in fies_suffixes) {
  col <- paste0("fies_cat_", s)
  md[, (col) := dt[match(md$id, dt$id), get(col)]]
  md[get(col) == "severe", (col) := "moderate"]
  md[, (col) := factor(get(col),
                       levels  = c("food_secure", "moderate"),
                       ordered = F)]
}

# fies_low: irgendeine der acht FAO-Fragen mit "Ja" beantwortet
fun.x <- function(x) as.numeric(
  ifelse(x %chin% c("weiß ich nicht", "keine Angabe"), NA,
  ifelse(x == "Ja", 1, 0))
)
f9_mat <- as.data.table(lapply(dt[match(md$id, dt$id), paste0("f9_", 1:8), with = FALSE], fun.x))
md[, fies_low := rowSums(f9_mat, na.rm = TRUE) > 0]
md[is.na(fies_cat_gesamt), fies_low := NA]

# Dreistufige FIES-Zusammenfassung (für Summary-Tabelle)
md[, fies_mild_mod := fifelse(fies_cat_gesamt == "moderate", "moderate",
                      fifelse(fies_low == TRUE,              "mild", "secure"))]
md[, fies_mild_mod := factor(fies_mild_mod, levels = c("secure", "mild", "moderate"))]

# fp_child: Sorge um Ernährung der Kinder (aus f8); 0-Kinder-HH zwingend 0
md[, fp_child := as.integer(fcase(
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), f8] == "Ja",   1,
  dt[match(md$id, dt$id), f8] == "Nein", 0
))]
md[ih_dem_children == 0, fp_child := 0L]
```

```{r shared-setup}
# Small helper — assigns a row's group from its term/variable name
assign_group <- function(x) {
  for (pattern in names(level_labels)) {
    if (grepl(pattern, x)) return(level_labels[[pattern]])
  }
  NA_character_
}

# Ableitung der 4-stufigen Haushaltskomposition aus children (Zähler) + hhtype.
# Wird nach Imputation in jedem completed dataset angewendet.
add_hhcomp <- function(d) {
  d[, ih_lc_hhcomp := fcase(
    ih_dem_children == 0 & ih_lc_hhtype == "multi-adult",  "couple_no_kids",
    ih_dem_children == 0 & ih_lc_hhtype == "single-adult", "single_no_kids",
    ih_dem_children >  0 & ih_lc_hhtype == "multi-adult",  "couple_kids",
    ih_dem_children >  0 & ih_lc_hhtype == "single-adult", "single_parent"
  )]
  d[, ih_lc_hhcomp := factor(ih_lc_hhcomp,
      levels = c("couple_no_kids","single_no_kids","couple_kids","single_parent"))]
  d[]
}
```

## Regression functions

### Raking setup (defined once, reused by all three outcomes)

```{r raking-setup}
# Target margins come from the FULL md sample (not the analytic subset)
make_target <- function(var) {
  md[!is.na(get(var)),
     .(Freq = sum(ctrl_weight, na.rm = TRUE)),
     by = var]
}
targets <- list(
  education  = make_target("ih_st_education"),
  gender     = make_target("ih_dem_gender"),
  employment = make_target("ih_st_employment"),
  bundesland = make_target("ctrl_bundesland")
)

rake_weights <- function(data) {
  design <- svydesign(ids = ~1, data = data, weights = ~ctrl_weight)
  design_raked <- rake(
    design,
    sample.margins     = list(~ih_st_education, ~ih_dem_gender,
                              ~ih_st_employment, ~ctrl_bundesland),
    population.margins = targets,
    control = list(maxit = 20, epsilon = 1e-7)
  )
  weights(design_raked)
}

# Descriptive-analysis raked weights (complete cases on outcome)
dt_descr <- md[!is.na(fies_cat_gesamt),
               .(id, ih_st_education, ih_dem_gender, ih_st_employment,
                 ctrl_bundesland, ctrl_weight)] |> na.omit()
dt_descr[, ctrl_weight_raked := rake_weights(dt_descr)]
dt_descr[, weightrakep := ctrl_weight_raked / sum(ctrl_weight_raked) * 100]
dtl[, weightrakep := dt_descr[match(dtl$id, dt_descr$id), weightrakep]]
```


### One runner for imputation + raking (per outcome)

```{r run-outcome}
# Imputation + raking only. Produces the per-imputation raked datasets that the
# six-table pipeline consumes (res_<mode>$imp$raked). The former block-wise
# model fitting / VIF / AME formatting has been removed: the Lund tables do
# their own survey-GLM estimation downstream.
run_outcome <- function(outcome_col,
                        include_method = TRUE,
                        m_imp          = 20,
                        maxit_imp      = 10,
                        seed           = 42) {

  # ---- Set outcome and subset to its responders
  md[, fies_binary := get(outcome_col)]
  imp_sample <- md[!is.na(fies_binary)]
  cat("Imputation sample N:", imp_sample[, .N], "\n")

  vars     <- if (include_method) imp_vars else setdiff(imp_vars, "ctrl_method")
  imp_data <- imp_sample[, .SD, .SDcols = c(vars, "id")]

  # ---- Imputation setup: don't impute outcome or controls
  init <- mice(imp_data, maxit = 0, printFlag = FALSE)
  meth <- init$method
  pred <- init$predictorMatrix
  pred[, "id"] <- 0
  for (v in c("fies_binary", "ctrl_weight", "ctrl_bundesland")) meth[v] <- ""
  if (include_method) meth["ctrl_method"] <- ""

  # fp_child: childless HHs are locked to 0, so they are not imputation targets.
  where_mat <- init$where
  where_mat[imp_data$ih_dem_children == 0, "fp_child"] <- FALSE

  set.seed(seed)
  imp <- futuremice(imp_data, m = m_imp, method = meth,
                    predictorMatrix = pred, where = where_mat,
                    maxit = maxit_imp, parallelseed = 123, print = FALSE)
  plan(sequential)

  # Re-assert deterministic 0 for childless HHs, derive household composition,
  # and rake within each completed dataset.
  imp_raked <- lapply(seq_len(imp$m), function(i) {
    d <- as.data.table(complete(imp, i))
    d[ih_dem_children == 0, fp_child := 0L]
    d <- add_hhcomp(d)
    d[, ctrl_weight_raked := rake_weights(d)]
    d
  })
  cat("Imputed + raked datasets ready:", length(imp_raked), "\n")

  list(imp = list(raked = imp_raked))
}
```

```{r imputation-sanity, eval=FALSE}
# Confirm childless HHs still have fp_child == 0 in every imputed dataset.
sanity <- sapply(res_moderate$imp$raked, function(d)
  all(d[ih_dem_children == 0, fp_child] == 0))
stopifnot(all(sanity))

# Confirm fp_child has no NA in any imputed dataset.
stopifnot(all(sapply(res_moderate$imp$raked, function(d)
  !any(is.na(d$fp_child)))))

# Confirm migration and the new priorities are present and complete.
new_vars <- c("ih_dem_migration", "ih_dem_agebr",
              "ih_fc_appetite", "ih_fc_weight", "ih_fc_social_norm",
              "ih_fc_impression", "ih_fc_hunger", "ih_fc_convenience",
              "ih_fc_tradition", "ih_fc_environment")
stopifnot(all(sapply(res_moderate$imp$raked, function(d)
  all(new_vars %in% names(d)) && all(!is.na(d[, ..new_vars])))))
```

```{r run-all}
res_moderate <- run_outcome("fies_cat_gesamt",  include_method = TRUE)
res_phone    <- run_outcome("fies_cat_telefon", include_method = FALSE)
res_online   <- run_outcome("fies_cat_online",  include_method = FALSE)

# Optional: propagate the moderate-model imputation weights back to dt / dtl

imp_dt_full[, impN := rep(seq_along(res_moderate$imp$raked),
                          each = nrow(res_moderate$imp$raked[[1]]))]
imp_weightrp <- imp_dt_full[, .(weightr = mean(ctrl_weight_raked)), id
                           ][, weightrp := weightr / sum(weightr)]
for (d in list(dt, dtl)) {
  d[, weightr  := imp_weightrp[match(d$id, imp_weightrp$id), weightr]]
  d[, weightrp := imp_weightrp[match(d$id, imp_weightrp$id), weightrp]]
}
```

## Word export helper

```{r export}
# Word writer used by the six-table Lund pipeline.
write_tables_to_word <- function(table_list, table_names,
                                 output_path = "regression_tables.docx") {
  doc <- read_docx() |>
    body_set_default_section(prop_section(
      page_size    = page_size(width = 11.7, height = 8.3, orient = "landscape"),
      page_margins = page_mar(top = 0.5, bottom = 0.5, left = 0.5, right = 0.5)))

  for (i in seq_along(table_list)) {
    tbl <- as.data.frame(table_list[[i]])
    ft  <- flextable(tbl) |>
      bold(part = "header") |>
      fontsize(size = 8,  part = "body") |>
      fontsize(size = 9,  part = "header") |>
      font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") |>
      align(j = 1:2,         align = "left",   part = "all") |>
      align(j = 3:ncol(tbl), align = "center", part = "all") |>
      padding(padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2,
              padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4, part = "all")

# Bold significant cells. p-value columns (header "p (...)"): bold when the
    # parsed value < .05 (handles "<0.001"). Other columns keep the legacy
    # star / "<" marker rule for backward safety.
    pcol <- startsWith(names(tbl), "p (")
    for (j in 2:ncol(tbl)) for (r in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
      v <- tbl[r, j]
      if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) next
      sig <- if (pcol[j]) {
        num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^<", "", v)))
        !is.na(num) && num < 0.05
      } else grepl("\\*", v) || grepl("^\\s*<", v)
      if (sig) ft <- bold(ft, i = r, j = j, bold = TRUE)
    }
    
    ft <- ft |> autofit() |> fit_to_width(max_width = 10.7)
    doc <- doc |>
      body_add_par(table_names[[i]], style = "heading 1") |>
      body_add_flextable(ft)
    if (i < length(table_list)) doc <- doc |> body_add_break()
  }

  print(doc, target = output_path)
  message("Saved to: ", output_path)
  invisible(output_path)
}
new_landscape_doc <- function()
  read_docx() |>
    body_set_default_section(prop_section(
      page_size    = page_size(width = 11.7, height = 8.3, orient = "landscape"),
      page_margins = page_mar(top = 0.5, bottom = 0.5, left = 0.5, right = 0.5)))

make_flextable <- function(tbl) {
  tbl <- as.data.frame(tbl); nc <- ncol(tbl)
  ft  <- flextable(tbl) |>
    bold(part = "header") |>
    fontsize(size = 8, part = "body") |>
    fontsize(size = 9, part = "header") |>
    font(fontname = "Arial", part = "all") |>
    align(j = seq_len(min(2, nc)), align = "left", part = "all") |>
    padding(padding.top = 2, padding.bottom = 2,
            padding.left = 4, padding.right = 4, part = "all")
  if (nc >= 3) ft <- align(ft, j = 3:nc, align = "center", part = "all")

  # Display every internal "p (...)" column as "p-value".
  pcols <- names(tbl)[startsWith(names(tbl), "p (")]
  if (length(pcols))
    ft <- set_header_labels(ft,
      values = setNames(as.list(rep("p-value", length(pcols))), pcols))

  # Bold significant cells (p-value cols parsed; others keep star/"<" rule).
  pcol <- startsWith(names(tbl), "p (")
  for (j in 2:nc) for (r in seq_len(nrow(tbl))) {
    v <- tbl[r, j]
    if (is.na(v) || !nzchar(v)) next
    sig <- if (pcol[j]) {
      num <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(sub("^<", "", v))); !is.na(num) && num < 0.05
    } else grepl("\\*", v) || grepl("^\\s*<", v)
    if (sig) ft <- bold(ft, i = r, j = j, bold = TRUE)
  }
  ft |> autofit() |> fit_to_width(max_width = 10.7)
}

# Single-file writer (used by manuscript export and the overview table).
write_tables_to_word <- function(table_list, table_names,
                                 output_path = "regression_tables.docx") {
  doc <- new_landscape_doc()
  for (i in seq_along(table_list)) {
    doc <- doc |>
      body_add_par(table_names[[i]], style = "heading 1") |>
      body_add_flextable(make_flextable(table_list[[i]]))
    if (i < length(table_list)) doc <- doc |> body_add_break()
  }
  print(doc, target = output_path); invisible(output_path)
}
```
# Lund-style Tables 2 and 3 — mode-specific, sum-of-posterior outcome

Drop-in replacement for the previous "Lund" section. Produces SIX Word files:

  lund_tables_gesamt.docx              lund_tables_gesamt_completecase.docx
  lund_tables_telefon.docx             lund_tables_telefon_completecase.docx
  lund_tables_online.docx              lund_tables_online_completecase.docx

Each file holds Table 2 (personal/household determinants) and Table 3
(food-environment associations) for one survey mode.

Design:
- Outcome is the continuous Rasch moderate+severe posterior probability
  `p_ms.<mode>` (FAO sum-of-posterior), modelled with an identity-link survey
  Gaussian GLM, so a coefficient x100 is a percentage-point change (PPC).
- gesamt -> res_moderate, telefon -> res_phone, online -> res_online.
- Imputed version pools 20 datasets by Rubin's rules (MIcombine / pool / D1);
  the complete-case version runs the identical code path on a single
  listwise-deleted, raked dataset (length-1 design list -> no pooling).
- PH = personal + household adjustment set (survey method folds into PH for
  gesamt only). SEM = social-ecological model = PH + LASSO-selected motives
  + all provisioning/social variables.
- LASSO selection uses the stacked multiply-imputed design (1/m weights,
  respondent-blocked CV folds, PH forced in unpenalised); the rule
  (lambda.min / lambda.1se / none) is set by LASSO_RULE, and per-imputation
  selection frequency is printed as a stability diagnostic.
- Table 3 displays ALL food motives (except very-low-n "what others do" /
  "making an impression"); only LASSO-selected motives enter the SEM set.
- Joint significance in both tables uses the same Rubin-pooled multivariate
  Wald test (mice::D2): Table 2 tests each factor on the
  continuous outcome; Table 3 block subheadings test the block as predictors of
  binary FI status under each specification (unadjusted / PH / PH+Block / SEM).

Requires the run-all chunk (res_moderate/phone/online) to have run first.

### Setup and shared helpers

```{r lund-setup}
library(survey); library(mice); library(mitools); library(data.table); library(glmnet)
library(car)   # car::vif for the collinearity table

stopifnot(exists("res_moderate"), exists("res_phone"), exists("res_online"))
stopifnot(all(c("p_ms.gesamt","p_ms.telefon","p_ms.online") %in% names(dt)))

`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (is.null(a) || length(a) == 0) b else a

stars_p <- function(p) if (is.na(p)) "" else
  if (p < .001) "***" else if (p < .01) "**" else if (p < .05) "*" else ""
fmt_p <- function(p) if (is.na(p)) "" else
  if (p < .001) "<0.001" else if (p < .01) "<0.01" else
  if (p < .05) "<0.05" else sprintf("%.3f", p)
# p-value to 3 decimals; "<0.001" for very small. Bolding (p<.05) is applied
# downstream in write_tables_to_word by parsing these cells.
fmt_pval3 <- function(p) if (is.na(p)) "" else
  if (p < .001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", p)

# Coefficient cell without stars (significance now lives in the adjacent p col).
fmt_rr_coef <- function(r) if (is.na(r$rr)) "" else sprintf("%.1f", r$rr * 100)
fmt_rr <- function(r) if (is.na(r$rr)) "" else sprintf("%.1f%s", r$rr * 100, stars_p(r$p))

# ---- Mode wiring -----------------------------------------------------------
mode_res <- list(gesamt = res_moderate, telefon = res_phone, online = res_online)
mode_pms <- c(gesamt = "p_ms.gesamt", telefon = "p_ms.telefon", online = "p_ms.online")
mode_cat <- c(gesamt = "fies_cat_gesamt", telefon = "fies_cat_telefon", online = "fies_cat_online")

# ---- Supplementary labels (merged into shared term_labels) -----------------
.extra_labels <- c(
  "ih_dem_agebr"       = "Age",
  "ih_dem_agebr18-34"  = "18-34", "ih_dem_agebr35-49" = "35-49",
  "ih_dem_agebr50-64"  = "50-64", "ih_dem_agebr65+"   = "65+",
  "ih_lc_health"       = "Health status",
  "ih_lc_healthgood"   = "good", "ih_lc_healthmedium" = "medium",
  "ih_lc_healthbad"    = "bad",
  "ih_fc_appetite"     = "Appetite",    "ih_fc_weight"      = "Weight control",
  "ih_fc_hunger"       = "Hunger",      "ih_fc_convenience" = "Convenience",
  "ih_fc_tradition"    = "Tradition",   "ih_fc_environment" = "Environment",
  "com_walk_dist_15"   = "Walking distance >= 15 min"
)
term_labels <- c(term_labels,
                 .extra_labels[setdiff(names(.extra_labels), names(term_labels))])

# Motive (food-choice) labels per the TEMS dimensions. These OVERRIDE any
# earlier ih_fc_* labels. Mapping derived from the German item labels:
#   Genuss->Pleasure, Appetit->Visual Appeal, Emotion->Affect Regulation,
#   Gemeinschaft->Sociability, Umwelt->Natural Concerns, Hunger->Need & Hunger.
# Note: the data has no separate "Liking" or "Overall" motive.
motive_labels <- c(
  "ih_fc_price"       = "Price",
  "ih_fc_hunger"      = "Need & Hunger",
  "ih_fc_health"      = "Health",
  "ih_fc_enjoyment"   = "Enjoyment",
  "ih_fc_habit"       = "Habits",
  "ih_fc_convenience" = "Convenience",
  "ih_fc_tradition"   = "Traditional Eating",
  "ih_fc_community"   = "Sociability",
  "ih_fc_emotion"     = "Affect Regulation",
  "ih_fc_appetite"    = "Appetite",
  "ih_fc_weight"      = "Weight Control",
  "ih_fc_environment" = "Environmental Concerns",
  "ih_fc_social_norm" = "Social Norms",
  "ih_fc_impression"  = "Social Image")
term_labels[names(motive_labels)] <- motive_labels
term_labels["fp_child"] <- "Worried about children"

lbl <- function(key, default = key)
  if (key %in% names(term_labels)) term_labels[[key]] else default

# ---- Variable sets (mode-independent; method handled per mode) -------------
BASE_PH <- c("ih_dem_agebr", "ih_dem_gender", "ih_dem_migration",
             "ih_st_education", "ih_st_employment",
             "ih_lc_hhcomp", "ih_lc_urban", "ih_lc_health")

# Priority candidates: 12 (drop very-low-n social_norm + impression).
CANDIDATES <- c("ih_fc_price", "ih_fc_hunger", "ih_fc_health", "ih_fc_enjoyment",
                "ih_fc_habit", "ih_fc_convenience", "ih_fc_tradition",
                "ih_fc_community", "ih_fc_emotion", "ih_fc_appetite",
                "ih_fc_weight", "ih_fc_environment")

PROVISIONING <- c("ip_sh_coping", "ip_fe_restaurant", "ip_fe_cafe",
                  "ip_fe_mensa_cost", "ip_fe_mensa_avail", "ip_fe_mensa_timo",
                  "com_walk_dist_15")
SOCIAL       <- c("ip_fe_host", "ip_fe_friends", "ip_sn_knows_fp")
ALWAYS_FOOD_ENV <- c(PROVISIONING, SOCIAL)

# Variables required complete for the complete-case frame.
ALL_MODEL_VARS <- c(BASE_PH, CANDIDATES, ALWAYS_FOOD_ENV)

# ---- prep(): finalize one dataset for a given mode -------------------------
# Idempotent: works on a completed imputed dataset OR an md subset. Attaches
# the unified outcome columns `p_ms` (continuous) and `fi` (0/1 moderate+
# severe), collapses health to 3 levels, sets reference levels (age 65+,
# employment retired), derives household composition + walk-distance binary.
make_lookup <- function(mode) {
  pms <- mode_pms[[mode]]; cat <- mode_cat[[mode]]
  dt[, .(id,
         .p_ms = get(pms),
         .fi   = fifelse(is.na(get(cat)), NA_integer_,
                         as.integer(get(cat) %in% c("moderate", "severe"))))]
}

prep <- function(d, mode) {
  d  <- copy(as.data.table(d))
  lk <- make_lookup(mode); m <- lk[match(d$id, lk$id)]
  d[, p_ms := m$.p_ms]
  d[, fi   := m$.fi]

  if (!is.null(d[["ih_lc_health"]])) {
    already <- is.factor(d$ih_lc_health) &&
               all(levels(d$ih_lc_health) %in% c("good", "medium", "bad"))
    if (!already) {
      hi <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(d$ih_lc_health))  # 1=very good ... 5=very bad
      d[, ih_lc_health := factor(
          fcase(hi %in% 1:2, "good", hi == 3, "medium", hi %in% 4:5, "bad"),
          levels = c("good", "medium", "bad"))]
    }
  }
  if (is.null(d[["ih_dem_agebr"]]) && !is.null(d[["ih_dem_age"]]))
    d[, ih_dem_agebr := cut(ih_dem_age, breaks = c(-Inf, 34, 49, 64, Inf),
                            labels = c("18-34", "35-49", "50-64", "65+"),
                            right = TRUE)]
if (!is.null(d[["ih_dem_agebr"]]))
    d[, ih_dem_agebr := factor(ih_dem_agebr,
                               levels = c("65+", "18-34", "35-49", "50-64"))]
  if (!is.null(d[["ih_st_employment"]]))
    d[, ih_st_employment := relevel(factor(ih_st_employment), ref = "retired")]
  if (is.null(d[["ih_lc_hhcomp"]]) &&
      !is.null(d[["ih_dem_children"]]) && !is.null(d[["ih_lc_hhtype"]]))
    d <- add_hhcomp(d)
  if (!is.null(d[["ih_lc_hhcomp"]]))
    d[, ih_lc_hhcomp := factor(ih_lc_hhcomp,
        levels = c("couple_no_kids", "single_no_kids",
                   "couple_kids", "single_parent"))]
  if (!is.null(d[["com_walk_dist"]]))
    d[, com_walk_dist_15 := as.integer(com_walk_dist >= 1)]
  d[]
}

# ---- Complete-case frame for the no-imputation tables ----------------------
build_cc_frame <- function(mode) {
  cat <- mode_cat[[mode]]
  ids <- dt[!is.na(get(cat)), id]
  base <- prep(md[id %in% ids], mode)
  needed <- intersect(c(ALL_MODEL_VARS, "p_ms", "fi"), names(base))
  cc <- base[stats::complete.cases(base[, ..needed])]
  w  <- tryCatch(rake_weights(cc), error = function(e) cc$ctrl_weight)
  cc[, ctrl_weight_raked := w]
  cc[]
}

# ---- Pooling / estimation primitives (take a list of survey designs) -------
as_mira <- function(fits) {
  obj <- list(call = NULL, call1 = NULL, nmis = NULL, analyses = fits)
  class(obj) <- c("mira", "matrix"); obj
}
svyglm_fits <- function(formula, designs, family = gaussian()) {
  Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(designs, function(des)
    tryCatch(svyglm(formula, design = des, family = family),
             error = function(e) NULL)))
}
pool_props <- function(stat_list) {
  if (length(stat_list) == 1) {                       # complete-case: m = 1
    e  <- as.numeric(coef(stat_list[[1]]))
    se <- sqrt(as.numeric(diag(as.matrix(vcov(stat_list[[1]])))))
    return(data.table(prev = e * 100,
                      lo = pmax(0,  (e - 1.96 * se) * 100),
                      hi = pmin(100, (e + 1.96 * se) * 100)))
  }
  mi <- MIcombine(results = lapply(stat_list, coef),
                  variances = lapply(stat_list, vcov))
  ci <- confint(mi)
  data.table(prev = as.numeric(coef(mi)) * 100,
             lo = pmax(0, ci[, 1] * 100), hi = pmin(100, ci[, 2] * 100))
}
prev_total <- function(designs, outcome = "p_ms")
  pool_props(lapply(designs, function(des)
    svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", outcome)), des, na.rm = TRUE)))

prev_by_level <- function(var, designs, outcome = "p_ms") {
  lv <- levels(as.factor(designs[[1]]$variables[[var]]))
  rbindlist(lapply(lv, function(l) {
    s <- lapply(designs, function(des)
      svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", outcome)),
              subset(des, des$variables[[var]] == l), na.rm = TRUE))
    p <- pool_props(s); p[, level := as.character(l)]; p
  }), fill = TRUE)
}
group_prev <- function(var, flag, designs)
  rbindlist(lapply(c("0", "1"), function(g) {
    s <- lapply(designs, function(des)
      svymean(as.formula(paste0("~", var)),
              subset(des, as.character(des$variables[[flag]]) == g), na.rm = TRUE))
    p <- pool_props(s); p[, grp := g]; p
  }), fill = TRUE)

pool_coef_tbl <- function(rhs_terms, designs, dv = "p_ms") {
  f <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + ")))
  fits <- svyglm_fits(f, designs)
  if (!length(fits)) return(NULL)
  if (length(fits) == 1) {                       # complete-case: no pooling
    sm <- tryCatch(summary(fits[[1]]), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(sm)) return(NULL)
    co <- as.data.table(sm$coefficients, keep.rownames = "term")
    setnames(co, c("term", "estimate", "std.error", "statistic", "p.value"))
    return(co)
  }
  tryCatch(as.data.table(summary(pool(as_mira(fits)))), error = function(e) NULL)
}

# Joint significance test used for BOTH tables (Table 2 factor tests on the
# continuous outcome; Table 3 block tests on binary FI), via standard package
# functions only. Multiply-imputed: fit the full and reduced models per dataset
# and pool the test with mice::D2 (combines per-imputation Wald statistics --
# robust when several parameters are dropped at once, unlike mice::D1, which it
# falls back to). Complete-case (m = 1): survey::regTermTest design-based Wald.
joint_test <- function(test_vars, rhs_terms, designs, dv = "fi") {
  if (!length(test_vars)) return(NA_real_)
  f_full <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + ")))
  if (length(designs) == 1) {                          # complete-case
    fit <- tryCatch(svyglm(f_full, designs[[1]], family = gaussian()),
                    error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NA_real_)
    tt <- tryCatch(regTermTest(fit,
            as.formula(paste("~", paste(test_vars, collapse = " + ")))),
            error = function(e) NULL)
    return(if (is.null(tt)) NA_real_ else as.numeric(tt$p))
  }
  reduced <- setdiff(rhs_terms, test_vars)
  f_red   <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~",
               if (length(reduced)) paste(reduced, collapse = " + ") else "1"))
  pairs <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(designs, function(des) {
    a <- tryCatch(svyglm(f_full, des, family = gaussian()), error = function(e) NULL)
    b <- tryCatch(svyglm(f_red,  des, family = gaussian()), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(a) || is.null(b)) NULL else list(a = a, b = b)
  }))
  if (!length(pairs)) return(NA_real_)
  A <- as_mira(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "a")); B <- as_mira(lapply(pairs, `[[`, "b"))
  res <- tryCatch(mice::D2(A, B),
                  error = function(e) tryCatch(mice::D1(A, B), error = function(e) NULL))
  if (is.null(res)) return(NA_real_)
  pcol <- intersect(c("P(>F)", "p.value"), colnames(res$result))
  if (!length(pcol)) return(NA_real_)
  as.numeric(res$result[1, pcol[1]])
}

# Map design-matrix columns back to their source variable (longest match).
col_to_var <- function(cols, varnames)
  vapply(cols, function(cn) {
    hits <- varnames[startsWith(cn, varnames)]
    if (length(hits)) hits[which.max(nchar(hits))] else NA_character_
  }, character(1))

# Collinearity: mean generalized VIF across datasets, reported as the adjusted
# GVIF^(1/(2*Df)) (Fox & Monette; equals sqrt(VIF) for 1-df terms, so the
# warning thresholds are ~2.24 for VIF>5 and ~3.16 for VIF>10). VIF is a
# property of the predictor space, so it is taken from an unweighted lm of the
# predictor set; factor terms are reported once (grouped), not per level.
vif_spec <- function(rhs_terms, dlist, dv = "p_ms") {
  if (length(rhs_terms) < 2) return(NULL)
  f <- as.formula(paste(dv, "~", paste(rhs_terms, collapse = " + ")))
  norm1 <- function(v)
    if (is.matrix(v)) setNames(v[, ncol(v)], rownames(v))
    else               setNames(sqrt(v), names(v))
  mats <- Filter(Negate(is.null), lapply(dlist, function(d) {
    fit <- tryCatch(stats::lm(f, data = d), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    tryCatch(norm1(car::vif(fit)), error = function(e) NULL)
  }))
  if (!length(mats)) return(NULL)
  alln <- Reduce(union, lapply(mats, names))
  setNames(vapply(alln, function(nm)
    mean(vapply(mats, function(x)
      if (nm %in% names(x)) x[[nm]] else NA_real_, numeric(1)), na.rm = TRUE),
    numeric(1)), alln)
}
```

### LASSO selection (stacked across imputations)

```{r lund-lasso}
# Which CV rule defines the SEM motive set:
#   "lambda.min" = least-penalised CV optimum (often retains most motives)
#   "lambda.1se" = parsimonious 1-SE rule (sparser selection)
#   "none"       = no selection; SEM uses all motives (LASSO switched off)
# lambda.min/1se are always computed and reported; this sets which feeds SEM.
LASSO_RULE <- "none"

# Main selector: one cv.glmnet on the stacked imputed datasets, each row
# weighted ctrl_weight_raked / m, CV folds blocked by respondent id (so all m
# copies of a person share a fold), PH + method forced in (zero penalty).
# Complete-case (single dataset) reduces to a plain weighted cv.glmnet.
run_lasso <- function(dlist, forced, wcol = "ctrl_weight_raked", dv = "p_ms") {
  mk_X <- function(d)
    model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(c(forced, CANDIDATES),
                 collapse = " + "))), data = d)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
  if (length(dlist) == 1) {
    X <- mk_X(dlist[[1]]); y <- dlist[[1]][[dv]]; w <- dlist[[1]][[wcol]]
    foldid <- NULL
  } else {
    Xs <- lapply(dlist, mk_X)
    common <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(Xs, colnames))
    X <- do.call(rbind, lapply(Xs, function(M) M[, common, drop = FALSE]))
    m <- length(dlist)
    y <- unlist(lapply(dlist, `[[`, dv))
    w <- unlist(lapply(dlist, `[[`, wcol)) / m
    ids <- unlist(lapply(dlist, `[[`, "id"))
    uid <- unique(ids); set.seed(1)
    fmap <- setNames(sample(rep(1:10, length.out = length(uid))), as.character(uid))
    foldid <- as.integer(fmap[as.character(ids)])
  }
  pf <- ifelse(col_to_var(colnames(X), c(forced, CANDIDATES)) %in% forced, 0, 1)
  set.seed(1)
  cvfit <- if (is.null(foldid))
    cv.glmnet(X, y, weights = w, family = "gaussian",
              penalty.factor = pf, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
  else
    cv.glmnet(X, y, weights = w, family = "gaussian",
              penalty.factor = pf, alpha = 1, foldid = foldid)
  retained <- function(s) {
    co  <- coef(cvfit, s = s)
    nz  <- setdiff(rownames(co)[abs(as.numeric(co)) > 1e-8], "(Intercept)")
    src <- col_to_var(nz, c(forced, CANDIDATES))
    unique(src[src %in% CANDIDATES])
  }
  list(min = retained("lambda.min"), se1 = retained("lambda.1se"))
}

# Stability diagnostic: % of imputations in which each candidate is selected.
lasso_frequency <- function(dlist, forced, wcol = "ctrl_weight_raked", dv = "p_ms") {
  sel <- lapply(seq_along(dlist), function(i) {
    d <- dlist[[i]]
    X <- model.matrix(as.formula(paste("~", paste(c(forced, CANDIDATES),
           collapse = " + "))), d)[, -1, drop = FALSE]
    pf <- ifelse(col_to_var(colnames(X), c(forced, CANDIDATES)) %in% forced, 0, 1)
    set.seed(i)
    cv <- cv.glmnet(X, d[[dv]], weights = d[[wcol]], family = "gaussian",
                    penalty.factor = pf, alpha = 1, nfolds = 10)
    co <- coef(cv, s = "lambda.min")
    nz <- setdiff(rownames(co)[abs(as.numeric(co)) > 1e-8], "(Intercept)")
    unique(col_to_var(nz, c(forced, CANDIDATES)))
  })
  tab <- table(factor(unlist(sel), levels = CANDIDATES))
  round(as.integer(tab) / length(dlist), 2) |> setNames(CANDIDATES)
}
```

### Table builders

```{r lund-builders}
# Returns list(t2, t3, vif, lasso_kept, lasso_kept_1se, freq) for one mode/version.
build_mode_set <- function(mode, use_imputation = TRUE) {
  res <- mode_res[[mode]]
  method_in_PH <- (mode == "gesamt") &&
    "ctrl_method" %in% names(res$imp$raked[[1]]) &&
    length(unique(na.omit(res$imp$raked[[1]]$ctrl_method))) > 1
  PH <- if (method_in_PH) c(BASE_PH, "ctrl_method") else BASE_PH

  if (use_imputation) dlist <- lapply(res$imp$raked, prep, mode = mode)
  else                dlist <- list(build_cc_frame(mode))
  designs <- lapply(dlist, function(d)
    svydesign(ids = ~1, weights = ~ctrl_weight_raked, data = d))
 analysis_n <- nrow(designs[[1]]$variables)   # actual modeling N for this combo
  md_obs <- prep(md[id %in% dt[!is.na(get(mode_cat[[mode]])), id]], mode)

  lr   <- run_lasso(dlist, PH)
  kept <- switch(LASSO_RULE,
                 "lambda.1se" = lr$se1,
                 "none"       = CANDIDATES,
                 lr$min)
  freq <- if (use_imputation) lasso_frequency(dlist, PH) else NULL
  SEM  <- c(PH, kept, ALWAYS_FOOD_ENV)

  cat(sprintf("\n[%s | %s] SEM motives (%s): %s\n",
              mode, if (use_imputation) "imputed" else "complete-case",
              LASSO_RULE, paste(kept, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] lambda.min set: %s\n", mode, paste(lr$min, collapse = ", ")))
  cat(sprintf("[%s] lambda.1se set: %s\n", mode, paste(lr$se1, collapse = ", ")))
  if (!is.null(freq)) {
    cat(sprintf("[%s] per-imputation selection frequency:\n", mode))
    print(freq[order(-freq)])
  }

  coefs_PH  <- pool_coef_tbl(PH,  designs)
  coefs_SEM <- pool_coef_tbl(SEM, designs)

  # ---- Table 2 -------------------------------------------------------------
  t2_vars <- if (method_in_PH) c(BASE_PH, "ctrl_method") else BASE_PH
  build_t2 <- function() {
    tot <- prev_total(designs, "p_ms")
    out <- list(data.table(
      `Factor & dimension` = "Total",
      `Prevalence % [CI 95%]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f-%.1f]", tot$prev, tot$lo, tot$hi),
      `PPC unadj.` = "", `p (unadj.)` = "",
      `PPC adj. IH` = "", `p (IH)` = "",
      `PPC adj. SEM` = "", `p (SEM)` = "",
      `N (NA)` = sprintf("%d (0)", nrow(md_obs))))

    for (var in t2_vars) {
      x  <- md_obs[[var]]
      bl <- table(x, useNA = "no")
      out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(
        `Factor & dimension` = lbl(var), `Prevalence % [CI 95%]` = "",
        `PPC unadj.` = "",   `p (unadj.)` = fmt_pval3(joint_test(var, var, designs, dv = "p_ms")),
        `PPC adj. IH` = "",  `p (IH)`     = fmt_pval3(joint_test(var, PH,  designs, dv = "p_ms")),
        `PPC adj. SEM` = "", `p (SEM)`    = fmt_pval3(joint_test(var, SEM, designs, dv = "p_ms")),
        `N (NA)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", sum(!is.na(x)), sum(is.na(x))))

      prev      <- prev_by_level(var, designs, "p_ms")
      lvl_order <- levels(as.factor(designs[[1]]$variables[[var]]))  # ref first
      prev      <- prev[match(lvl_order, level)][!is.na(level)]
      coefs_u   <- pool_coef_tbl(var, designs)

      for (i in seq_len(nrow(prev))) {
        lv <- prev$level[i]; key <- paste0(var, lv); is_ref <- (i == 1)
        ng <- bl[lv]; ng <- if (is.na(ng)) "" else as.character(ng)
        lab <- lbl(key, lv)
        coef_cell <- function(tbl) {
          if (is_ref) return("(ref)")
          if (is.null(tbl)) return("")
          r <- tbl[term == key]
          if (!nrow(r)) "" else sprintf("%.1f", r$estimate * 100)
        }
        p_cell <- function(tbl) {
          if (is_ref || is.null(tbl)) return("")
          r <- tbl[term == key]
          if (!nrow(r)) "" else fmt_pval3(r$p.value)
        }
        out[[length(out) + 1]] <- data.table(
          `Factor & dimension` = paste0("  ", lab),
          `Prevalence % [CI 95%]` = sprintf("%.1f [%.1f-%.1f]",
                                            prev$prev[i], prev$lo[i], prev$hi[i]),
          `PPC unadj.`  = coef_cell(coefs_u),   `p (unadj.)` = p_cell(coefs_u),
          `PPC adj. IH` = coef_cell(coefs_PH),  `p (IH)`     = p_cell(coefs_PH),
          `PPC adj. SEM`= coef_cell(coefs_SEM), `p (SEM)`    = p_cell(coefs_SEM),
          `N (NA)` = ng)
      }
    }
    rbindlist(out, fill = TRUE)
  }

  # ---- Table 3 -------------------------------------------------------------
  # Block order: motives -> social -> provisioning (manuscript order).
  t3_blocks <- list(
    "Food motives"                  = CANDIDATES,
    "Social food environment"       = SOCIAL,
    "Food provisioning environment" = PROVISIONING)
  block_of <- function(v) {
    for (b in names(t3_blocks)) if (v %in% t3_blocks[[b]]) return(t3_blocks[[b]])
    character(0)
  }
  # coef of `fi` in  var ~ fi + rhs.
  rr_flag <- function(var, rhs_terms, des = designs) {
    rhs  <- paste(unique(c("fi", rhs_terms)), collapse = " + ")
    fits <- svyglm_fits(as.formula(paste(var, "~", rhs)), des)
    if (!length(fits)) return(list(rr = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    if (length(fits) == 1) {                       # complete-case: no pooling
      sm <- tryCatch(summary(fits[[1]]), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(sm) || !("fi" %in% rownames(sm$coefficients)))
        return(list(rr = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
      cf <- sm$coefficients
      return(list(rr = cf["fi", 1], p = cf["fi", 4]))
    }
    ps <- tryCatch(as.data.table(summary(pool(as_mira(fits)))),
                   error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ps)) return(list(rr = NA_real_, p = NA_real_))
    r <- ps[term == "fi"]
    if (!nrow(r)) list(rr = NA_real_, p = NA_real_) else list(rr = r$estimate, p = r$p.value)
  }
  adj_rr <- function(var, full, des = designs)
    rr_flag(var, setdiff(if (full) SEM else PH, var), des)
  pct <- function(d) if (nrow(d)) sprintf("%.1f [%.1f-%.1f]", d$prev, d$lo, d$hi) else ""

  build_t3_row <- function(var) {
    gp    <- group_prev(var, "fi", designs)
    r_un  <- rr_flag(var, character(0)); r_ph <- adj_rr(var, FALSE)
    r_sem <- adj_rr(var, TRUE)
    x <- md_obs[[var]]
    data.table(
      `Level & dimension` = lbl(var),
      `Food secure`   = pct(gp[grp == "0"]),
      `Food insecure` = pct(gp[grp == "1"]),
      `PPC`          = fmt_rr_coef(r_un),  `p (unadj.)` = fmt_pval3(r_un$p),
      `PPC adj. IH`  = fmt_rr_coef(r_ph),  `p (IH)`     = fmt_pval3(r_ph$p),
      `PPC adj. SEM` = fmt_rr_coef(r_sem), `p (SEM)`    = fmt_pval3(r_sem$p),
      `N (NA)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", sum(!is.na(x)), sum(is.na(x))))
  }

  # fp_child: shown in the Social block but EXCLUDED from SEM; structural zero
  # for childless HHs, so estimated on the child-HH subsample only.
  build_t3_row_fpchild <- function() {
    var    <- "fp_child"
    dchild <- lapply(designs, function(d) subset(d, ih_dem_children > 0))
    gp     <- group_prev(var, "fi", dchild)
    r_un   <- rr_flag(var, character(0),     dchild)
    r_ph   <- rr_flag(var, setdiff(PH, var), dchild)
    x <- md_obs[ih_dem_children > 0][[var]]
    data.table(
      `Level & dimension` = lbl(var),
      `Food secure`   = pct(gp[grp == "0"]),
      `Food insecure` = pct(gp[grp == "1"]),
      `PPC`          = fmt_rr_coef(r_un),  `p (unadj.)` = fmt_pval3(r_un$p),
      `PPC adj. IH`  = fmt_rr_coef(r_ph),  `p (IH)`     = fmt_pval3(r_ph$p),
      `PPC adj. SEM` = "",                 `p (SEM)`    = "",
      `N (NA)` = sprintf("%d (%d)", sum(!is.na(x)), sum(is.na(x))))
  }

  block_header <- function(title, blockvars) {
    p_un  <- joint_test(blockvars, blockvars,        designs, "fi")
    p_ph  <- joint_test(blockvars, c(PH, blockvars), designs, "fi")
    inSEM <- intersect(blockvars, SEM)
    p_sem <- if (length(inSEM)) joint_test(inSEM, SEM, designs, "fi") else NA_real_
    data.table(
      `Level & dimension` = title, `Food secure` = "", `Food insecure` = "",
      `PPC`          = "", `p (unadj.)` = fmt_pval3(p_un),
      `PPC adj. IH`  = "", `p (IH)`     = fmt_pval3(p_ph),
      `PPC adj. SEM` = "", `p (SEM)`    = fmt_pval3(p_sem),
      `N (NA)` = "")
  }

  build_t3 <- function() {
    rows <- list()
    for (b in names(t3_blocks)) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- block_header(b, t3_blocks[[b]])
      for (v in t3_blocks[[b]]) rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- build_t3_row(v)
      if (b == "Social food environment")
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- build_t3_row_fpchild()
    }
    rbindlist(rows, fill = TRUE)
  }

  # ---- Table 4: collinearity (single column, Full specification) -----------
  build_vif <- function() {
    FULL <- c(PH, CANDIDATES, ALWAYS_FOOD_ENV)
    x    <- vif_spec(FULL, dlist = dlist)
    ord  <- c(PH, CANDIDATES, ALWAYS_FOOD_ENV)
    vars <- names(x); vars <- vars[order(match(vars, ord))]
    data.table(
      Term = vapply(vars, lbl, character(1)),
      `Adjusted GVIF^(1/2df)` = vapply(vars, function(v)
        if (!is.null(x) && v %in% names(x)) sprintf("%.2f", x[[v]]) else "",
        character(1)))
  }

  list(t2 = build_t2(), t3 = build_t3(), vif = build_vif(),
              n = analysis_n,
       lasso_kept = kept, lasso_kept_1se = lr$se1, freq = freq)
}
```

### Variable overview (descriptive)

```{r lund-overview}
# One-row-per-variable descriptive overview (unweighted, pre-imputation) on the
# gesamt analytic frame. Numeric / binary variables get mean/median/SD/min/max;
# factors get N, NA, and a level-count summary. Written to its own Word file.
var_overview <- function(data, vars) {
  rbindlist(lapply(vars, function(v) {
    x <- data[[v]]; n <- sum(!is.na(x)); na <- sum(is.na(x))
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      data.table(Variable = lbl(v), N = n, `NA` = na,
                 Mean   = round(mean(x,   na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                 Median = round(median(x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                 SD     = round(sd(x,     na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                 Min    = round(min(x,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                 Max    = round(max(x,    na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                 Levels = "")
    } else {
      lv <- table(x)
      data.table(Variable = lbl(v), N = n, `NA` = na,
                 Mean = NA_real_, Median = NA_real_, SD = NA_real_,
                 Min = NA_real_, Max = NA_real_,
                 Levels = paste(sprintf("%s: %d", names(lv), as.integer(lv)),
                                collapse = "; "))
    }
  }), fill = TRUE)
}

ov_data <- prep(md[id %in% dt[!is.na(fies_cat_gesamt), id]], "gesamt")
ov_vars <- c("p_ms", "ih_dem_age", "ih_dem_agebr", "ih_dem_gender",
             "ih_dem_migration", "ih_st_education", "ih_st_employment",
             "ih_lc_hhcomp", "ih_lc_urban", "ih_lc_health",
             CANDIDATES, PROVISIONING, SOCIAL, "fp_child")
overview_table <- var_overview(ov_data, intersect(ov_vars, names(ov_data)))

write_tables_to_word(
  table_list  = list(overview_table),
  table_names = list("Table 1. Variable overview (gesamt analytic sample, unweighted, pre-imputation). Numeric/binary variables: mean/median/SD/min/max; binary indicators are coded 0/1 so the mean is the prevalence. Factors: N, NA and level counts."),
  output_path = file.path(DIR_TAB, "variable_overview.docx"))

print(overview_table)
```

```{r lund-export}
tag_imp <- function(use_imp) if (use_imp) "" else "_completecase"
tag_lbl <- function(use_imp) if (use_imp) "20-imputation, raked" else "complete-case, raked"
mode_title <- c(gesamt = "Full sample (phone and online)",
                online = "Online sample", telefon = "Phone sample")

combos <- list(
  list(mode = "gesamt",  imp = TRUE),  list(mode = "gesamt",  imp = FALSE),
  list(mode = "online",  imp = TRUE),  list(mode = "online",  imp = FALSE),
  list(mode = "telefon", imp = TRUE),  list(mode = "telefon", imp = FALSE))

# ---- One combined appendix file (all six mode x version sets, with N (NA)) --
doc <- new_landscape_doc(); lund_out <- list(); first <- TRUE
for (cb in combos) {
  s <- build_mode_set(cb$mode, cb$imp)
  lund_out[[paste0(cb$mode, tag_imp(cb$imp))]] <- s
  caps <- list(
    sprintf("Table 2. FI prevalence (Rasch moderate+severe) by personal/household determinant - %s, %s. PPC = percentage-point change (Gaussian identity-link survey GLM, coef x100); IH = individual+household adjustment%s; SEM = social-ecological model. Header rows: joint Wald p; level rows: pooled coefficient p; bold if p<.05.",
            mode_title[[cb$mode]], tag_lbl(cb$imp),
            if (cb$mode == "gesamt") " incl. survey method" else ""),
    sprintf("Table 3. FI x food-environment associations - %s, %s. Food secure/insecure = weighted prevalence within FI group. PPC = percentage-point difference (coef x100); IH adjusts for individual/household; SEM = full model. Block subheadings give the joint test of the block; bold if p<.05.",
            mode_title[[cb$mode]], tag_lbl(cb$imp)),
    sprintf("Table 4. Collinearity diagnostics - %s, %s. Adjusted GVIF^(1/2df) (= sqrt(VIF) for single-df terms), averaged across datasets; ~2.24 = VIF 5, ~3.16 = VIF 10. Full specification (IH + all motives + provisioning/social).",
            mode_title[[cb$mode]], tag_lbl(cb$imp)))
  if (!first) doc <- doc |> body_add_break()
doc <- doc |> body_add_par(
    sprintf("%s - %s (n = %d)", mode_title[[cb$mode]], tag_lbl(cb$imp), s$n),
    style = "heading 1")
tbls <- list(s$t2, s$t3, s$vif)
  for (k in seq_along(tbls)) {
    doc <- doc |> body_add_par(caps[[k]], style = "heading 2") |>
                  body_add_flextable(make_flextable(tbls[[k]]))
    if (k < length(tbls)) doc <- doc |> body_add_break()
  }
  first <- FALSE
}
```

```{r worries-children}
Q <- "f8"
ja_ids <- dtl[grepl(Q, qid) & itlb == "Ja", unique(id)]

# Helper: weighted share of "worried" within a given universe
worried_rate <- function(universe_dt, label) {
  d <- copy(universe_dt)[!is.na(weightr), .(id, weightr)]
  d[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% ja_ids)]
  des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d)
  est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
  cat(sprintf("%-45s %.1f%% (n = %d/%d, 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f)\n",
              label, 100 * coef(est), sum(d$endorsed), nrow(d),
              100 * attr(est, "ci")[1], 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2]))
  invisible(est)
}

# Joint rate: share who BOTH have kids AND are worried, over broader universe
joint_rate <- function(universe_dt, label) {
  d <- copy(universe_dt)[!is.na(weightr), .(id, weightr, kids)]
  d[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% ja_ids & kids == TRUE)]
  des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d)
  est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
  cat(sprintf("%-45s %.1f%% (n = %d/%d, 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f)\n",
              label, 100 * coef(est), sum(d$endorsed), nrow(d),
              100 * attr(est, "ci")[1], 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2]))
  invisible(est)
}

# Conditional rates: share worried AMONG households with children
worried_rate(dt[kids == TRUE], "All HH with kids — share worried:")
worried_rate(dt[kids == TRUE & descr_sample == TRUE], "FI HH with kids — share worried:")

# Joint rates over broader universes
joint_rate(dt, "Total population — share with kids AND worried:")
joint_rate(dt[descr_sample == TRUE], "FI population — share with kids AND worried:")
```

```{r gender-shopper-skipper}
# ---- Build long-format plot data -------------------------------------------
build_gender_plotdata <- function(data = d) {
  get_share_num <- function(d_sub, var) {
    if (nrow(d_sub) == 0) return(data.table(value = NA_real_, ci_low = NA_real_,
                                            ci_high = NA_real_, n_sum = NA_real_, n_tot = 0L))
    d_sub <- copy(d_sub)
    d_sub[, endorsed := get(var)]
    if (all(is.na(d_sub$endorsed))) return(data.table(value = NA_real_, ci_low = NA_real_,
                                                      ci_high = NA_real_, n_sum = NA_real_,
                                                      n_tot = nrow(d_sub)))
    des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d_sub)
    est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
    data.table(value   = 100 * coef(est),
               ci_low  = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[1],
               ci_high = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2],
               n_sum   = sum(d_sub$endorsed),
               n_tot   = nrow(d_sub))
  }

  groups <- list(
    `Male respondants`   = data[gender == "male"],
    `Female respondants` = data[gender == "female"],
    `All respondants`    = data
  )

  rbindlist(lapply(names(groups), function(g) {
    d_mp <- groups[[g]][multi_person == TRUE]
    rbindlist(list(
      cbind(group = g, metric = "Women responsibility", get_share_num(d_mp, "fshare_shopper")),
      cbind(group = g, metric = "Men responsibility",   get_share_num(d_mp, "mshare_shopper")),
      cbind(group = g, metric = "Women skipping",       get_share_num(d_mp, "fshare_skipper")),
      cbind(group = g, metric = "Men skipping",         get_share_num(d_mp, "mshare_skipper")),
      cbind(group = g, metric = "None skipping",        get_share_num(d_mp, "no_skipper"))
    ))
  }))
}
```

## social participation

### meeting others (f22)

```{r participation-frequency}
# ---- Helper: weighted shares + CI per response category --------------------
build_freq_tab <- function(Q, drop_labels = c("weiß nicht", "keine Angabe"),
                           category_order = NULL) {
  resp <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid), .(id, itlb)]
  resp <- resp[!is.na(itlb) & !itlb %in% drop_labels]
  if (is.null(category_order)) category_order <- unique(resp$itlb)
  resp[, itlb := factor(itlb, levels = category_order)]

  d <- dt[descr_sample == TRUE, .(id, weightr)]

  rbindlist(lapply(category_order, function(cat) {
    cat_ids <- resp[itlb == cat, id]
    d_tmp <- copy(d)[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% cat_ids)]
    des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d_tmp)
    est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
    data.table(category = cat,
               pct      = 100 * coef(est),
               n        = sum(d_tmp$endorsed),
               ci_low   = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[1],
               ci_high  = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2])
  }))[, category := factor(category, levels = category_order)][]
}
```

## gender breakdown of shopper/skipper (table)

```{r gender-table}
# d already has: id, weightr, multi_person, fshare_shopper, fshare_skipper
# Attach respondent gender
d[, gender := dt[match(d$id, dt$id), gender]]

# Simple console printout, stratified by respondent gender
share_with_ci_by_gender <- function(var_name, label, data = d, subset_expr = NULL) {
  d_tmp <- copy(data)
  if (!is.null(subset_expr)) d_tmp <- d_tmp[eval(subset_expr)]
  d_tmp[, endorsed := get(var_name)]
  cat(sprintf("\n=== %s ===\n", label))
  for (g in c("female", "male")) {
    d_g <- d_tmp[gender == g]
    if (nrow(d_g) == 0) next
    des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d_g)
    est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
    cat(sprintf("  %-8s %.1f%% (sum = %.1f/%d, 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f)\n",
                paste0(g, ":"),
                100 * coef(est), sum(d_g$endorsed), nrow(d_g),
                100 * attr(est, "ci")[1], 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2]))
  }
  invisible(NULL)
}

share_with_ci_by_gender("fshare_shopper",
                        "Female-shopper share, by respondent gender (multi-person HH)",
                        subset_expr = quote(multi_person == TRUE))
share_with_ci_by_gender("fshare_skipper",
                        "Female meal-skipper share, by respondent gender",
                        subset_expr = quote(multi_person == TRUE))
share_with_ci_by_gender("multi_person",
                        "In multi-person HH, by respondent gender",
                        data = copy(d)[, multi_person := as.integer(multi_person)])

# Pretty table for export
build_gender_table <- function(data = d) {
  get_share <- function(d_sub, var) {
    if (nrow(d_sub) == 0) return(NA_character_)
    d_sub <- copy(d_sub)
    d_sub[, endorsed := get(var)]
    if (all(is.na(d_sub$endorsed))) return(NA_character_)
    des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d_sub)
    est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
    sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f–%.1f] (n=%.1f/%d)",
            100 * coef(est),
            100 * attr(est, "ci")[1],
            100 * attr(est, "ci")[2],
            sum(d_sub$endorsed),
            nrow(d_sub))
  }

  groups <- list(
    Male   = data[gender == "male"],
    Female = data[gender == "female"],
    Both   = data
  )

  rbindlist(lapply(names(groups), function(g) {
    d_g  <- groups[[g]]
    d_mp <- d_g[multi_person == TRUE]
    data.table(
      `Gender respondent`       = g,
      `Multi-person households` = get_share(copy(d_g)[, mp_int := as.integer(multi_person)], "mp_int"),
      `Shopping women`          = get_share(d_mp, "fshare_shopper"),
      `Skipping women`          = get_share(d_mp, "fshare_skipper")
    )
  }))
}

clipr_table <- function(x) {
  html <- x %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric),
                  ~ formatC(round(.x, 2), decimal.mark = ",", format = "f", digits = 2))) %>%
    knitr::kable(format = "html") %>%
    as.character()
}

tbl <- build_gender_table(d)
tbl %>% clipr_table()
```

## reasons (f24–f28)

```{r reasons}
library(survey)
library(data.table)

# ---- Helper: frequency table with weighted shares + CIs --------------------
# qtype = "single"   → iterate over itlb values (one selection per respondent)
# qtype = "multiple" → iterate over qlb values (one yes/no per item)
build_freq_table <- function(Q, qtype = c("single", "multiple"),
                             drop = c("weiß nicht", "weiß ich nicht", "keine Angabe")) {
  qtype <- match.arg(qtype)

  if (qtype == "single") {
    resp <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid), .(id, key = itlb)]
  } else {
    resp <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid) & itlb == "genannt",
                .(id, key = qlb)]
  }
  resp <- resp[!is.na(key) & !key %in% drop]

  categories <- unique(resp$key)
  d <- dt[descr_sample == TRUE, .(id, weightr)]

  out <- rbindlist(lapply(categories, function(cat) {
    cat_ids <- resp[key == cat, unique(id)]
    d_tmp <- copy(d)[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% cat_ids)]
    des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d_tmp)
    est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
    data.table(category = cat,
               pct      = round(100 * coef(est),         1),
               n        = sum(d_tmp$endorsed),
               total_n  = nrow(d_tmp),
               ci_low   = round(100 * attr(est, "ci")[1], 1),
               ci_high  = round(100 * attr(est, "ci")[2], 1))
  }))

  out[order(-pct)]
}

# Build the five tables

tab_f25 <- build_freq_table("f25", "multiple")  # reasons for not inviting

tab_f27 <- build_freq_table("f27", "multiple")  # where do you eat out?
tab_f28 <- build_freq_table("f28", "multiple")  # why don't you eat out?

# Pretty-printed "X% (n=Y/N) [lo–hi]"
add_label_col <- function(tab) {
  tab[, share := sprintf("%s%% (n=%d/%d) [%s–%s]",
                         point(pct), n, total_n,
                         point(ci_low), point(ci_high))]
  tab[, .(category, share)]
}

# Prepare plotting data (rename pct→value to match expected structure)
prep_plot_data <- function(tab, translations) {
  tab <- copy(tab)
  tab[, category := translations[as.character(category)]]
  setorder(tab, pct)  # ascending so largest is at top in horizontal bar
  tab[, category := factor(category, levels = category)]
  tab[, lbl := sprintf("%.1f%% [%.1f–%.1f]", pct, ci_low, ci_high)]
  setnames(tab, c("category", "pct"), c("qlb", "value"))
  tab
}

            family = "Times New Roman") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 70, 10), limits = c(0, 75), expand = c(0, 0)) +

  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 70), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    text             = element_text(family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 11 * .7),
    axis.line.x      = element_line(linewidth = .25),
    axis.line.y      = element_line(linewidth = 0),
    axis.ticks.x     = element_line(linewidth = .25),
    axis.ticks.y     = element_line(linewidth = 0),
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.box       = "vertical",
    plot.margin      = margin(5, 100, 5, 5),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text       = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 11)
  )
```

```{r needs-simple}
# ---- F30: simple Ja-share --------------------------------------------------
Q <- "f30"
d <- dt[descr_sample == TRUE, .(id, weightr)]
ja_ids <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid) & itlb == "Ja", id]
d[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% ja_ids)]

 dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid),.N,itlb]

des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d)
est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
sprintf("%.1f%% (n = %d/%d, 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f)",
        100 * coef(est), sum(d$endorsed), nrow(d),
        100 * attr(est, "ci")[1], 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2])

# ---- F32: "eher stark" + "sehr stark" --------------------------------------
Q <- "f32"

              itlb %chin% c("eher stark", "sehr stark"), id]

des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d)
est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
sprintf("%.1f%% (n = %d/%d, 95%% CI %.1f–%.1f)",
```

```{r needs-plot}
X     <- dtl
Q     <- "f31"
D     <- doc
L     <- lb
xmax  <- 45
RM    <- c("weiß n|andere|keine a")
FIGH  <- 1.2
xstep <- 5
WRAP  <- 30

TITLE    <- paste0(L[qid == Q, qt[1]])
SUBTITLE <- paste0(gsub("F", "Frage ", toupper(Q)), ": ", L[qid == Q, qf[1]])

# Manual reassignment of one item to "Versorgungssystem" group
dtl[qlb == "billigere gesunde und umweltfreundliche Lebensmittel", itgroup := "Versorgungssystem"]

# Tabulate by item AND itgroup
tab <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE][
  grepl(Q, qid) & itlb == "genannt",
  .(label = paste0(point(round(sum(weightrpds), 1)), " %",
                   " (n = ", formatC(.N, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ","), ")"),
    value = sum(weightrpds), .N),
  by = .(qlb, itgroup)
]

# Order items by combined total share, then by itgroup
tab[, total  := sum(value),  by = qlb]
tab[, valueg := max(total),  by = itgroup]
setorder(tab, valueg, total)
tab[, qlb     := factor(qlb,     levels = unique(qlb))]
tab[, itgroup := as.character(itgroup)]
tab[, itgroup := factor(itgroup, levels = rev(unique(itgroup)))]

# Move dropped items into BOX text
tab[grep(RM, qlb, ignore.case = TRUE), BOX := paste(qlb, ": ", label, collapse = " \n")]
BOX <- tab[, .(BOX)][!is.na(BOX), unique(.SD)][, paste0(BOX, collapse = "\n\n")]
tab <- tab[grep(RM, qlb, ignore.case = TRUE, invert = TRUE)]
GES <- dtl[!is.na(weightrpds)][grep(RM, qlb, ignore.case = TRUE, invert = TRUE)][
  grep(Q, qid)][!duplicated(id),
  .(point(round(sum(weightrpds), 1)), uniqueN(id))]
BOX <- paste0("gesamt: ", GES[, V1], " % (n = ", GES[, V2], ")\n",
              BOX, "\n\nMehrfachantworten möglich")

# Endorsement = 1 if respondent (a) wanted to change AND (b) named this item; else 0.
# Non-changers stay as structural zeros.
items <- unique(dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid) &
                    !grepl(RM, qlb, ignore.case = TRUE), qlb])

ci_results <- rbindlist(lapply(items, function(it) {
  d <- dt[descr_sample == TRUE, .(id, weightr)]
  endorsed_ids <- dtl[descr_sample == TRUE & grepl(Q, qid) &
                      qlb == it & itlb == "genannt", id]
  d[, endorsed := as.integer(id %in% endorsed_ids)]
  des <- svydesign(ids = ~id, weights = ~weightr, data = d)
  est <- svyciprop(~endorsed, des, method = "logit")
  data.table(qlb     = it,
             value   = 100 * coef(est),
             ci_low  = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[1],
             ci_high = 100 * attr(est, "ci")[2],
             N       = sum(d$endorsed))
}))

tab[ci_results, on = "qlb", `:=`(ci_low = i.ci_low, ci_high = i.ci_high)]
tab[, lbl := sprintf("%s%% [%s–%s]",
                     point(round(value,   1)),
                     point(round(ci_low,  1)),
                     point(round(ci_high, 1)))]
```
